title: Abahambi bentsimi eluhlaza
intro: Kudala, abantu ababini babenyamekela amazwe angabamelwane. Iindlela zabo zazidibene, kodwa iintliziyo zabo zazibakhokelela kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo kakhulu. Omnye wayehamba ngendlela ethe tye, ngelixa omnye wayephambukela ebumnyameni bokungakholelwa. Ungasityhila imfihlakalo yaba bagcini babini besivuno?
clues: Ndandinesivuno esikhulu, isivuno esihle esasimangalisa amehlo abantu ababebukele.
Ummelwane wam wayenezinwe ezininzi kunam, kodwa ndandinqwenela isabelo sabo ngaphezu kwesam.
Ndicebise ukuba sizitshabalalise ngokupheleleyo izityalo zabo, ukuze sihlanganise yonke into ephantsi kolawulo lwam.
Ndizitshabalalise nesivuno sam, nditshabalalisa yonke into ngecebo lam lobudenge.
Ndema ndingenakuzinceda njengoko izityalo zam zibuna kwaye ubutyebi bam buguquka baba luthuli ngobusuku obunye.
Andizange ndibe nasabelo kwiLizwe Elizayo, kwaye indawo yam yokugqibela yaba ngumngxuma womlilo ovuthayo.
